note: Art origins, best first. The client prefixes the image URLs of the art manifests with the first source that answers (/asset-mirrors.json is its probe), falling back to the game server — see docs/ASSETS.md. `http://123.57.150.185` is the owner's own relay (Aliyun Beijing, 200 Mbps, nginx over a clone of this repository's public/): it mirrors the whole tree AND reimplements the game's extension-less routes (/media, /scene, /clip), so it can carry everything, not only images. The two free CDN mirrors below only serve plain files (they have no /media, /scene or /clip), and github raw is often unreachable from mainland China — which is why the relay comes first. Update the owner/repo in the CDN entries if the repository moves.
